# Vendored chess rules library

- Upstream: https://github.com/Disservin/chess-library
- Revision: `53e6a841dcda7059a2af363d85f785ef1817304a`
- Header version: 0.9.4
- License: MIT; original text in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Header source: https://github.com/Disservin/chess-library/blob/53e6a841dcda7059a2af363d85f785ef1817304a/include/chess.hpp

`chess.hpp` and `LICENSE` are unmodified upstream files supplying position
representation, legal moves, make/unmake, and rules checks. ChessLab's own search
and evaluation live separately in `engine/src/`.
